Hiring: Fullstack Engineer and UI Designer (Remote, LATAM) – BudgetSimple

BudgetSimple is a no-code app and site builder for personal finance coaches, creators, and advisors.

We’re growing the platform and looking for: * Fullstack Engineer * UI Designer

Both roles will work directly with the founder on a real, production SaaS used by paying customers.

Fullstack Engineer React, Python (Flask), Postgres Build and ship full features end to end Care about clean code and simple systems Bonus: SaaS, no-code tools, Stripe

UI Designer Design clean, modern, highly usable web app interfaces Dashboards, forms, workflows, design systems Strong product thinking and attention to detail Bonus: SaaS, fintech, no-code products

Both roles are fully remote. We are specifically looking for candidates based in South America, Central America, or Mexico.

Email sam [at] budgetsimple [dot] com with: A short intro Links to work you’ve built or designed

Thanks!
